risks.title: A librarian lends a held copy to the wrong member
risks.bound: The printed slip is the only guard until the desk app reads holds. The night report lists copies lent while held.

risks.title: Ready emails land in spam
risks.bound: My holds shows ready holds too, so a member who checks it still sees the day.

risks.title: The night run misses a day
risks.bound: The next run passes on every copy past its day, so a copy waits one extra day at most.

defaults.says: Three opening days count from the morning after a copy is shelved.
defaults.note: The desk asked for opening days. Calendar days would be simpler.

defaults.says: The pickup branch is the member's home branch unless they pick another.
